name: Testosterone cypionate
description: A long-chain ester of testosterone in oil, approved for testosterone replacement in males with primary or hypogonadotropic hypogonadism. A Schedule III controlled substance in the United States.

systems.note: Androgen replacement is the labelled indication; placed on the gonads by intended effect.
Lean-mass accrual is an intended and labelled effect of androgen replacement.
Erythrocytosis is a labelled risk of exogenous androgen.
Prostatic growth and rising PSA are labelled.
Androgen class hepatic effects; the ester route lowers but does not remove the concern.
Blood pressure rise and cardiovascular signals are labelled.

monitors.why: The direct index of replacement adequacy; labelled monitoring parameter.
Testosterone aromatises; estradiol drives several androgen-therapy effects.
Erythrocytosis is the labelled haematological risk.
Read with haematocrit for the erythrocytosis signal.
Completes the red-cell picture behind the labelled erythrocytosis risk.
Labelled prostate monitoring for men on androgen replacement.
Exogenous androgen suppresses gonadotropins; documents axis shutdown.
